payload.pattern: shared-doctor session-coherence probes read studio-ops own root, not the caller project
payload.context: scripts/run-doctor.mjs (studio-ops) wires session-number-freshness / last-session-summary / closeout-session-coherence via sessionNumberFreshnessRun(ROOT) / lastSessionSummaryRun(ROOT) / closeoutSessionCoherenceRun(ROOT) where ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, ..) i.e. the studio-ops repo itself. Every sibling repo spawns this upstream doctor with cwd:REPO_ROOT set to ITS OWN root, but these 3 inline probes ignore process.cwd() and always read studio-ops own context/PROJECT_STATUS.json + SELF_IMPROVEMENT_LOOP.md + LATEST_HANDOFF.md instead of the calling project files. Result: every sibling checkout gets a persistent false session-number-freshness / last-session-summary / closeout-session-coherence warning (living-protocol S224 observed lastSession=218<S219 stuck even after local lastSession was bumped to 223 across 5 sessions), because the probe never actually reads the calling repo state.
payload.solution: in vaultspark-studio-ops/scripts/run-doctor.mjs change the 3 inline call sites (grep sessionNumberFreshnessRun(ROOT), lastSessionSummaryRun(ROOT), closeoutSessionCoherenceRun(ROOT)) to pass process.cwd() instead of the module-level ROOT constant, matching the cwd:REPO_ROOT already set by the spawnSync caller. No sibling-tree edit made from living-protocol per CANON-018 - shipping as cargo instead.
